summary: PERMS-CAREGIVER-1 Milestone 1 (Family Members invite model + screen) tested end-to-end on web + backend. 11/11 pytest cases pass. All acceptance criteria in the review request verified: capacity block on GET /api/household/members with correct Family plan seats + owner account_holder role + invites/expired split; PC-D23 409 email_registered block with exact spec copy (including support@wayly.com.au); fresh-email caregiver invite succeeds with legal_role_declared False; Guardian (legal) sets legal_role_declared True; invalid relationship → 422; 4th caregiver at seat cap → 400; resend extends expires_at (200); revoke removes invite (200); unknown token → 404; cross-household user cannot resend/revoke another household's token. Web /settings/members verified: subhead no longer contains 'Everyone sees the statements and audit log', seat counter renders 'N of 5 people invited. K spaces remaining.', all required testIDs present (invite-role-participant, invite-role-caregiver, invite-relationship-select, invite-note-input, invite-email-error), PC-D23 inline error shows the exact spec copy and NO invite is created. Test invites cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: Copy-paste risk (backend/server.py:1043): PC-D23 email-registered lookup uses only db.users. Once tokenized signup-via-invite lands, ensure it ALSO blocks emails that are already in db.invites (pending) or db.household_members to keep 'one household per email' invariant across all sources of truth.

resend_invite (backend/server.py:1113) does not check that the invite is currently 'pending' before resetting expires_at — it re-activates any status back to pending. If a revoked/expired-then-declined invite still exists in the collection, resend would silently resurrect it. Milestone 1 revoke uses DELETE so this is moot today, but worth guarding when approval/decline states land.

list_members (server.py:1176) computes people_used = 1 (owner) + members + pending_invites, but does not subtract when a member is both an active member AND has a lingering pending invite for the same email. Not observable now (active membership is created via accept-invite which deletes the invite in a later milestone), but flag for later milestones.
